definitions.explanation: The order of roads or paths to follow to reach a destination. Refers both to the physical route and to verbal or written directions explaining how to get somewhere.

examples.japanese: {道順|みちじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{地図|ちず}→地図：02914_chizu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{道順|みちじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the route on the map.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道順|みちじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧おいた。
examples.english: I wrote down the directions from the station to the hotel on a memo.

notes:
Combines ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (road) and ⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧ (order/sequence). Emphasizes the step-by-step order of the route rather than just the destination.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {道順|みちじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧ — to give directions
- {道順|みちじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧ — to look up directions
- {道順|みちじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧ — to confirm the route
- {道順|みちじゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}える→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧ — to take the wrong route

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ルート→ルート：11250_ruuto⟧ — route (loanword, often for planned travel or hiking routes)
- ⟦{行|い}き→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ — how to get there (more conversational)
- ⟦{経路|けいろ}→経路：13796_keiro⟧ — route, path (more formal/technical, also used for data routes)
